verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents in-app AI features. AI commit message suggestions are generated from the user's own changes, and AI-assisted mock generation turns the user's prompts, OpenAPI definitions or URL responses into mock APIs. These are narrow, task-specific suggestions rather than general AI insights over the user's API data, such as response analysis or anomaly or test suggestions. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of request/response data, broader suggestion features beyond commit messages and mocks, detailed documentation of how the suggestions work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI commit message suggestions, which help maintain clear and atomic commit histories.
AI-assisted mock server generation, which transforms prompts or API definitions into mock APIs.
Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.
